it.PROCESS_NOT_RUNNING.title: Comando già finito
it.PROCESS_NOT_RUNNING.explanation: Questo comando non è più in corso: è finito da solo, o qualcuno l’ha già fermato.

it.PROCESS_STILL_RUNNING.title: Comando ancora in corso
it.PROCESS_STILL_RUNNING.explanation: Si può togliere dall'elenco solo un comando finito.

en.PROCESS_NOT_RUNNING.message: This command is no longer running
en.PROCESS_STILL_RUNNING.message: This command is still running: stop it first
en.PROCESS_NOT_RUNNING.title: Command already finished
en.PROCESS_NOT_RUNNING.explanation: This command is no longer running: it finished on its own, or someone already stopped it.
en.PROCESS_NOT_RUNNING.action: Look at the row in the Processes tab: it says how it ended.
en.PROCESS_STILL_RUNNING.title: Command still running
en.PROCESS_STILL_RUNNING.explanation: Only a finished command can be removed from the list.
en.PROCESS_STILL_RUNNING.action: Stop it first, then remove it.
